findings.claim: v2 deletes withRetry. That code came from the #218 crash fix, and no v2 doc names #218 or has a test for it.
findings.evidence: cm-main src/db-base.ts:432 'withRetry(fn, delays = [100, 500, 2000])', :446 busy loop. 'git log -S' finds that it came from 13dcec21. 'grep #218' in docs/v2 and PRD-v2.md finds nothing. verify-single-db.md:47 says a lock held longer than the timeout fails with 'database is locked'.
findings.fix: Add #218 to the store row of the GP table. Add a golden test: hold a lock longer than busy_timeout, then check that the server and hooks do not crash (the hook drops the event, the tool returns a typed error).
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 13dcec21 2026-04-02 'fix: handle SQLITE_BUSY with retry logic and graceful errors (closes #218)'; extracted in 09185d3e 2026-04-02. ORIGINAL_INTENT: '#218 MCP server crashes under multi-session SQLite contention (SQLITE_BUSY)' (isall.json, CLOSED). REGRESSION_RISK: if v2 removes the retry but does not handle BUSY, the #218 crash comes back. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no busy loop (#985), no retry chain; one BEGIN IMMEDIATE with busy_timeout, and a typed error that does not crash.

findings.claim: The bug form speaks to a person. The user rule says the issue template must target AI agents, make them follow our rules and send as much debug data as possible.
findings.evidence: ADR-0014:56 and the tested draft /tmp/wf4/sk/gh/bug.yml:7-16 ('Get the report: 1. ... run /ctx-doctor ... 2. Copy the block ... 3. Paste it below'). The form has no part that tells an agent what to do: call ctx_doctor itself, paste the output unchanged, fill every field, never summarize, and not open an issue for v1. The report also leaves out error messages and paths (ADR-0014:42).
findings.fix: Add an 'If you are an AI agent' block at the top of every form. It must list the steps (call the ctx_doctor tool, paste the block unchanged, fill each required field from tool output, name the denied tool and the alternative), list the rules (v2 only, no PRs, no secrets), and ask for the most debug data that is safe to send (all typed rows, hook timings, deny_7d, error codes). Keep the typed redaction.
